job.topic: Como o café chegou ao Brasil

creative_direction.thesis_placeholder: Uma frase que explique por que Como o café chegou ao Brasil importa.
creative_direction.variation_guard: Não repetir a mesma combinação de arquétipo, gramática visual, voz e música dos trabalhos recentes.

audio.narration_direction_english: Brazilian Portuguese, natural regional pronunciation, clear documentary storytelling, emotionally controlled and intelligible. Female-presenting, warm, grounded and expressive; calm authority with human closeness. Write and perform only the Portuguese spoken script after the colon. Use short natural pauses after dates, numbers and revelations; do not sound rushed.
audio.music_prompt_english: Instrumental only, no vocals. Minimal marimba or plucked motif, soft bass pulse, small tonal surprises at revelations, playful but credible, never louder than narration. Tempo target: 96–118 BPM. Duration: approximately 60.0 seconds.
mix_rules: Narration stays intelligible and in front.
Duck music by approximately 8 dB under speech, then adjust by ear.
Use SFX only for visible or narratively justified events.
Leave a clean 1.5–2 second musical tail at the ending.
